_note: Names the press prints for a bill that its generated press_names lack. Each name is OR-ed onto that bill's nightly coverage search (scripts/press-names.mjs, scripts/coverage-query.mjs queryWithAddedNames): nothing generated is removed, and nothing in this file is shown on a page. Every name must be printed in at least one cited stored headline, or the whole file is rejected for the night. Evidence rule, the same for every outlet, rated or not: every headline stored in data/coverage.json that prints the name and was published on or after the recorded vote the note names. Hand-maintained; changes go through a pull request the owner merges.
